claims.text: The Palazzo is on the north-center Las Vegas Strip, sharing a complex with The Venetian and the Grand Canal Shoppes.

findings.quote: North-center Strip, sharing a complex with The Venetian and the Grand Canal Shoppes

claims.text: Guests can walk indoors between the Palazzo and Venetian towers and use all of The Venetian's amenities.

findings.quote: you can walk indoors between towers and use all of Venetian’s amenities

claims.text: Every suite has a marble bathroom, a workspace, a living area and a pillow-top bed.

findings.quote: Enjoy understated elegance in every suite with a marble bathroom, a workspace, a living area and a luxurious pillow-top bed.

claims.text: The Luxury King Suite Sphere View has views of the Sphere at The Venetian.

findings.quote: Refined Italian glamour meets Las Vegas adventure in this luxury suite with views of the Sphere at The Venetian.

claims.text: The Grand One Bedroom King Suite has a double-door entrance, a marble foyer, a living area, a dining table for four and a private bedroom with one king bed.

findings.quote: Experience a new level of luxury in this expansive suite offering a double-door entrance, a marble foyer, a living area, a dining table for four and a private bedroom with one king bed.

claims.text: Prestige Club Lounge suites include a welcome glass of prosecco at check-in, a personal concierge and breakfast.

findings.quote: Prestige Club Lounge suites also include a welcome glass of prosecco upon check-in, a personal concierge and complimentary breakfast.

claims.text: The resort has heated swimming pools.

findings.quote: heated swimming pools

claims.text: TAO Beach is a pool deck with live DJ sets and drinks.

findings.quote: Become one with the music at this electrifying pool deck offering live DJ sets, drinks and more.

claims.text: The Palazzo Casino Floor offers a full range of casino games and a high-limit lounge.

findings.quote: Try your luck on The Palazzo Casino Floor offering a full range of casino games, an elegant high-limit lounge

claims.text: The Palazzo has Silver LEED certification and energy-efficient systems.

findings.quote: Silver LEED certification, energy-efficient systems

claims.text: The Grand Canal Shoppes are downstairs from the Palazzo.

findings.quote: The Grand Canal Shoppes are essentially your downstairs mall

claims.text: WAKUDA in The Palazzo Lobby serves sushi, with a late-night dinner menu and an omakase experience.

findings.quote: Enjoy exceptional sushi at this upscale restaurant offering a late-night dinner menu and an Omakase experience in The Palazzo Lobby.

claims.text: The Palazzo Luxury King Suite Strip View has a sunken living room and a Roman tub.

findings.quote: Revel in the comfort of the sunken living room, sink into the Roman tub for a serene soak

findings.quote: Starting at 720 square feet

findings.quote: Enjoy an indoor or outdoor gondola ride on this picture-perfect rendition of the Grand Canal inspired by the famous waterway of Venice.

claims.text: Guests have access to Canyon Ranch Spa + Fitness, with climbing walls, hydrotherapy and wellness consults.

findings.quote: Canyon Ranch Spa + Fitness for climbing walls, hydrotherapy, and wellness consults

claims.text: Prestige-level suites have access to the 23rd-floor lounge, with breakfast, evening bites and Strip views.
